skill.name: security-fundamentals

content.value_statement: Security review can miss basic authentication, authorization, and input handling flaws. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a focused OWASP checklist for application reviews.
actual_capabilities: Reviews authentication flows for password storage, token expiry, and secure transmission.
Checks authorization logic for ownership rules, role checks, and server-side enforcement.
Flags unsafe input handling patterns such as unvalidated input and string-built queries.
Prompts reviewers to reduce sensitive data exposure in responses, logs, and URLs.
Provides deployment checks for HTTPS, security headers, CSRF protection, and rate limiting.
limitations: Does not run automated vulnerability scans or dependency audits.
Does not prove code is secure without human review and testing.
Focuses on common application risks, not specialized cryptography design.
Requires access to relevant code paths to produce useful review feedback.

use_cases.title: Review a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Apply a security checklist before merging changes that touch APIs, auth flows, or user input.

use_cases.title: Coach Junior Reviewers
use_cases.description: Use Socratic questions to help newer engineers identify trust boundaries and exposure risks.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Release Check
use_cases.description: Verify deployment basics such as HTTPS, rate limits, headers, and sensitive response fields.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Security Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a small feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this change for security basics. Focus on input validation, authentication, authorization, and sensitive data exposure.

prompt_templates.title: API Endpoint Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of a user-facing endpoint.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these API endpoints using the security fundamentals checklist. Identify trust boundaries, missing ownership checks, and risky response fields.

prompt_templates.title: Auth Flow Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of login, sessions, or roles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this authentication and authorization flow. Check password handling, token lifetime, role verification, and server-side access control.

prompt_templates.title: Release Security Gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a release security gate for this service. Prioritize exploitable issues, required fixes, and deployment risks before production.

output_examples.input: Review a new profile update endpoint before merge.
output: High risk: The endpoint updates any profile ID without proving ownership.
Medium risk: The response includes internal account fields that users do not need.
Suggested fix: Enforce server-side ownership checks and return only public profile fields.

output_examples.input: Check a login flow for common security gaps.
output: Password handling looks appropriate if a slow hash is used with a unique salt.
Add rate limiting and account lockout controls for repeated failures.
Confirm session tokens expire and are only sent over HTTPS.

output_examples.input: Prepare a security checklist for a production API release.
output: Verify HTTPS enforcement, security headers, and CSRF protection where needed.
Confirm sensitive fields are excluded from logs and responses.
Test authorization on every protected route with another user account.

best_practices: Review server-side checks before trusting any client-provided value.
Ask for the worst realistic abuse case when reviewing each endpoint.
Document each security concern with impact, evidence, and a concrete fix.
anti_patterns: Approving code because the client UI hides restricted actions.
Returning full database objects from user-facing responses.
Treating security review as complete without checking deployment settings.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews common application security areas, including input validation, authentication, authorization, data exposure, and deployment readiness.

faq.question: Does it run a vulnerability scanner?
faq.answer: No. It provides structured review guidance and questions for an AI assistant to apply to code.

faq.question: Can it replace a security engineer?
faq.answer: No. It helps reviewers find common issues, but high-risk systems still need expert assessment.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Why are risky code snippets present?
faq.answer: They are negative examples that show reviewers what to reject or question during a security review.

faq.question: When should I apply it?
faq.answer: Use it when reviewing user-facing code, auth changes, database queries, file uploads, or API responses.
